parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by modifying the signature inspection to consider type aliases, but it may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of inspect.signature by adding the 'type_aliases' parameter, which might affect other parts of the codebase that rely on the original behavior.
